scientific_question: The seven-trunk endpoint passes the local common-gradient gate but remains 0.0698 CE behind its attention-only dense-MLP control. Is the residual primarily an MLP endpoint-value mismatch, an input-Jacobian mismatch, or upstream/temporal compounding?

teacher.role: matched full-attention control with dense layer-private MLPs

state_banks: candidate MLP inputs collected from the candidate forward
teacher MLP inputs collected from the teacher forward
measurement.comparison: evaluate both MLPs on both input banks; teacher outputs and teacher input-JVPs are the targets

classification_order: if the output gate fails: ENDPOINT_VALUE_MISMATCH
else if the input-JVP gate fails: INPUT_JACOBIAN_MISMATCH

theory.reason: common-gradient recovery tests whether layers locally request compatible movement, not whether a shared trunk has reached the distinct layerwise functions accumulated by dense training
theory.two_sided_reason: testing both state banks separates a representation defect from a result that appears only because the two independently trained models visit different residual-stream states
theory.jvp_reason: matching outputs alone can hide a wrong GELU activation partition or wrong local derivative field

authorization.allowed: one zero-update endpoint/JVP oracle on the exact checkpoints above
not_allowed: an eighth trunk or boundary sweep
authorization.after_result: update the theory note and design only the obstruction-specific compact representation; require a separate preregistration before any training
